title: Newhalo header
description: A fixed, see-through header for black first screens: large wordmark left, small centred links (the current one orange with a dot), a white button and two quiet squares right. It slides away as you scroll down and returns on solid black when you scroll up. Phones get a short button and a menu square that opens a full-height list.
notes: made for a black first section (the hero panel or a page hero): it is transparent at the top
name: newhalo-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the wordmark, set large in the display face

props.name: brandIcon
props.description: an icon shown before the wordmark (e.g. a lucide icon)

props.name: links
props.description: the centred navigation (desktop) and the menu panel (phones)

props.name: cta
props.type: { label: string; shortLabel?: string | undefined; href: string; }
props.description: the white button at the right; shortLabel is used on phones

props.name: language
props.description: a small language switch next to the button (desktop)

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: screen-reader name of the accessibility button; leave out to hide it

props.name: menuLabels
props.description: screen-reader names of the menu button
